details:
GStreamer is a streaming media framework based on graphs of filters which operate on media data. The gstreamer1-plugins-good packages contain a collection of well-supported plug-ins of good quality and under the LGPL license.  

Security Fix(es):  

  * gstreamer: GStreamer: Remote Code Execution via MRF file parsing heap-based buffer overflow (CVE-2026-18296)
  * gstreamer: GStreamer: Remote code execution via heap-based buffer overflow in PNG file parsing (CVE-2026-18298)
  * gstreamer: GStreamer: Remote Code Execution via Use-After-Free in rtpsbcdepay (CVE-2026-18299)
  * GStreamer: GStreamer: Remote code execution via MRF file parsing (CVE-2026-18295)


For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
